designAuthority.source: Accepted MFR-002 U08 contract plus the established FI-09, FI-10, FI-11, theme, and responsive design-system contracts

change.receiving: Receiving now leads with inbound and discrepancy work, keeps the authoritative record and cumulative consequence visible, and uses an exact review-before-submit sequence with a fresh server-state recheck before any governed evidence or command.
change.procurement: Procurement presents canvass, supplier, and deliverable consequence as one operational workspace while retaining server-owned status, permissions, and action availability.
change.events: Events now leads with one semantic activity logistics report; series and day context are secondary disclosures with independent loading, empty, denied, and unavailable truth rather than inferred readiness.
change.administration: Administration now uses one page-bounded semantic record list with local search, a mobile focus-trapped full-viewport inspector, a desktop persistent inspector, capability-derived sections, safe opaque identity handling, and a separate privileged danger zone for the exact existing reset contract.
change.index: The Playground Index is now a launcher-first QA surface: route search and public/authenticated filters lead, runtime health and recents stay compact, and technical route contracts are selection-disclosed in native details without weakening one-click launch.
change.truthBoundary: No readiness, inventory, receiving, procurement, event, administration, authorization, identity, reset, or runtime state is fabricated. Loading, authentication, unavailable, rejected, and not-reported states remain distinguishable and retry clears a rejected runtime probe.
change.responsiveArchitecture: Each changed workspace keeps a single semantic responsive representation. Narrow layouts use intentional list-to-inspector transitions; wide layouts preserve persistent context without duplicating records in separate mobile and desktop DOM trees.

performance.measurementProfile: U07 and U08 canonical Vite artifacts were built from the same dependency graph; direct transfer is entry HTML plus its directly referenced CSS and JavaScript, compressed with Node zlib level 9.

d1Effect.indexDecision: NO_INDEX_OR_MIGRATION_IN_VISUAL_U08; ACCEPTED U09 RETAINS MEASURED DATA_PATH_HARDENING_AUTHORITY

accessibility.receiving: Mobile list-to-detail selection, desktop persistent context, exact final confirmation, inert background, focus containment, Escape and opener restoration, whole-number constraints, and pre-upload server recheck are preserved.
accessibility.operationalRecords: Procurement and Events use a single responsive semantic record representation; status and readiness remain text-backed rather than color-only.
accessibility.administrationInspector: At narrow widths the selected record opens in a labelled, full-viewport modal inspector with initial focus, Tab containment, Escape, inert background, body-scroll restoration, and opener-focus restoration. Wide layouts use a persistent complementary inspector.
accessibility.privilegedActions: The exact reset confirmation remains isolated in a labelled danger/privileged zone and is not implied for accounts without the governing capability.
accessibility.index: Primary route search, filters, and one-click launch precede optional technical detail. Native details/summary controls preserve keyboard access, runtime states are text-labelled, and rejected runtime discovery can be retried.
accessibility.themeAndMotion: Semantic status, notice, surface, and consequence tokens preserve six theme families and twelve Light/Dark appearances; reduced-motion and forced-colors behavior remains supported.

renderedBrowser.attempt: The frontend-390 U08 Administration journey was launched and stopped before rendering because the project-pinned Chromium executable is absent.
renderedBrowser.notClaimed: No fresh rendered five-width, keyboard, 200 percent reflow, focus-obscuration, visual-regression, Web Vitals, INP, route-ready, or live API latency PASS is claimed for U08.
fallbackEvidence: The complete frontend configuration enumerates 535 cases across five viewport projects and 15 files.

Focused contracts cover responsive Administration inspector semantics, safe identity projection, capability-derived tabs, exact reset boundary, Events source-state independence, launcher hierarchy, runtime-state truth, retry, recents, and route registry status.
Canonical and staging React artifacts compile through Vite and pass fixture-boundary, design, contrast, normal-asset, deploy-marker, and byte-identical hero gates.

rollback: Revert the four isolated U08 source commits and this closeout commit. No migration, index, backend, provider, deployment, or data rollback is required.
